The desk pet moves onto the board, and a round of editor and gesture fixes. 1.10.0 never shipped, so this is the update for anyone on 1.9.0 and carries everything since.

## Highlights

- **The pet is a tile now.** Add "Zwierzak" from the action catalog. It lands as a 2x2 tile that draws the animal right on the board: sprite, four mini stat bars and the R.I.P. screen. The old sidebar panel is gone. You can add several pet tiles; they all show the same animal, on this machine and everywhere else.
- **Tablets look after it too.** The Android client draws each species natively (blob, cat, frog, chick, axolotl), with its mood face, the sleep Zzz and poos. The gestures match the tools: tap feeds, double-tap plays, long-press cleans, and on a dead pet long-press lays a new egg.
- **One shared pet.** The pet's state moved from per-machine localStorage to the server (`pulpitApp/pet.json`). The editor runs the simulation and pushes snapshots, tablets draw what they receive, and a care tap from any device goes back to the simulation. Stock Deckboard clients show the pet as a plain text line ("Kot · Zadowolone").
- **Sleep takes care of itself.** The sleep toggle and the petting button are gone. Rest drains, and when it runs out the pet curls up and naps until it is fully rested.
- **Your pet comes along.** The first launch after updating adopts the pet from 1.9.0: species, age, stats and family records.

## Fixes

- **Hold gestures that launch a program.** A Run Program tile with a hold (or any other) gesture passed its own gesture settings to the program as arguments, so a script received `{gestures:[long-press],...}` and rejected it. A plain tap on such a tile did the same. The program now starts without arguments.
- **New tile dialog.** Clicking Save on a new tile reopened the same dialog in edit mode. It now just closes.
- **Delete in the edit dialog.** The Delete button in the tile edit dialog did nothing. It now asks for confirmation and deletes the tile, like the context menu.
- **Dragging onto occupied cells.** A single tile dragged or resized onto cells another tile already uses is now refused instead of overlapping it.

## Notes

- Feeding wakes the pet. Events (hatch, growing up, poo, sleep, death) reach tablets at once, and the routine stat drain updates them about every 15 seconds.
- A headless server relays the pet but does not run the simulation. With only a server running, the pet pauses, the same mercy it gets when the app is closed.

## Install

- **Desktop**: update in-app or grab `pulpit-desktop-1.11.0.exe` below; the updater feed points here.
- **Android**: install `pulpit-1.11.0.apk` over the previous version.
